title: EasyLens: A Training-Free Plug-and-Play Subtle-Lesion Representation Amplifier for Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.06379v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation, including lesion detection and report generation. However, their practical utility remains limited by insufficient sensitivity to subtle lesions, whose visual evidence is often sparse, low-contrast, and embedded within complex anatomical context. As local visual tokens are aggregated, these weak lesion cues can become underrepresented in global image representations, making them difficult for medical VLMs to recognize. Existing efforts to improve lesion sensitivity mainly rely on medical-domain vision-encoder pre-training, clinical-term-guided alignment, or trainable pathological representation enhancement. translated_title: EasyLens：一种面向医学视觉-语言模型的免训练即插即用细微病灶表征放大器
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在临床图像解读方面（包括病灶检测和报告生成）展现出越来越大的潜力。然而，其实际应用仍然受限于对细微病灶的敏感性不足，这些细微病灶的视觉证据往往稀疏、低对比度，并嵌入在复杂的解剖背景之中。随着局部视觉标记被聚合，这些微弱的病灶线索在全局图像表征中的呈现可能不足，导致医学VLMs难以识别它们。现有的提升病灶敏感性的方法主要依赖医学领域的视觉编码器预训练、临床术语引导的对齐，或可训练的病理表征增强。尽管这些方法有效，但它们通常需要额外的训练或针对特定模型的适配，并且可能过度拟合特定的疾病形态，从而限制了其在冻结的医学VLMs上的适用性。为了解决……
tldr: 本文提出了EasyLens，一种无需训练、即插即用的细微病灶表征放大器，能够在不进行额外训练的情况下增强冻结的医学视觉-语言模型对细微病灶的识别敏感性。
en_tdlr: EasyLens is a training-free, plug-and-play subtle-lesion representation amplifier that enhances the sensitivity of frozen medical vision-language models to subtle lesions without requiring additional training.
